verdict.rationale: Square documents in-person acceptance on its own hardware and with Tap to Pay on iPhone, which needs no extra hardware. It also shows that newly created accounts get a default location managed in the Square Dashboard, and that card acceptance is available in eight countries. None of this evidences the signup-to-first-payment journey the story describes. missing for 10: documented signup and approval flow and its timing, ordering hardware from the dashboard, evidence of a same-week path to taking payments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
